question: Please list the average number of prenatal weeks in 2018 for counties in Wisconsin where more than 5% of the employed population had commutes of 45-59 minutes in 2017.
sql:
SELECT 
  ROUND(AVG(n.Ave_Number_of_Prenatal_Wks), 2) as avg_prenatal_weeks
FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2017_5yr` c
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_cdc_wonder_natality.county_natality` n
  ON c.geo_id = n.County_of_Residence_FIPS
WHERE c.geo_id LIKE '55%'
  AND SAFE_DIVIDE(c.commute_45_59_mins, c.employed_pop) > 0.05
  AND n.Year = DATE('2018-01-01')
  AND n.County_of_Residence_FIPS != '55999'
